senses.gloss: शृकालः A jackal; see शृगाल below.

सृकः [सृ-कक्]
—1 Air, wind.
—2 An arrow.
—3 A thunder-bolt.
—4 A lotus (कैरव).

सृकः + .{@-का@}
—1 A jackal.
—2 A crane.
—3 A hell.
—4 A kind of weapon; L. D. B.
